name: QTEdu
description: QTEdu is the European Quantum Flagship's coordination action for quantum technology education, providing a curated directory of quantum courses, programs, and training opportunities across Europe. The initiative developed the European Competence Framework for Quantum Technologies and supports the QTEdu Open Master pilot, which offers transferrable ECTS credits from quantum programs at multiple European universities.
